sloka: विश्वासात्कथितम् किम्चित्परिवादम् मिथः क्वचित् ।विवृणोतु स दुष्टात्मा यस्यार्योओऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-३२॥
transliteration: viśvāsātkathitam kimcitparivādam mithaḥ kvacit ।vivṛṇotu sa duṣṭātmā yasyāryoo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-32॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, acquire the sin in the same way as a wickedminded person, who divulges the words of abuse secretly confided in him by his friends.
